meta.description: Partial, manually-curated reference for Indonesia sharia stock status. This is NOT a complete Daftar Efek Syariah (DES) — it only contains the handful of tickers we could verify from public news coverage of BEI's periodic index evaluation. Anything not listed here returns 'unknown', not 'non-syariah'.
meta.secondary_source_for_full_list: https://www.idx.co.id (halaman IDX Syariah / konstituen JII, JII70, ISSI)
meta.how_to_update: Download DES terbaru dari OJK (diterbitkan Mei & November) atau daftar konstituen JII/JII70/ISSI dari IDX, lalu tambahkan simbol ke array 'confirmed_syariah' atau 'confirmed_removed' di bawah. Ticker tanpa suffix .JK.
